authorities.meaning: Merged main is the source authority after phase acceptance.
Linux, Windows, and macOS GitHub-hosted runners are the core runtime acceptance authority.
A phase is accepted only when its required workflow checks pass on the exact candidate commit.
Structured specs are semantic authority; docs/ is generated projection.
Pinned governance tooling and rules used by Phase 0.

invariants: Do not merge a phase while any required GitHub Actions check is failing or unproven.
After a phase merge, revalidate main before starting the next accepted baseline.
Generated docs must match the exact tracked source/spec snapshot.
